messages.subject: setting TMPDIR for shiny-server
parts:
I've been setting up a shiny-server on debian and would like any temporary files from R to be in a location that is not /tmp

I've tried setting TMPDIR and TMP environment variables before starting shiny-server but not succeeded so far. 

Am I on the wrong track?

By the way, I'll make a separate post about debian init.d scripts

Gareth

messages.author: b0b89f2bcaabb36a
messages.subject: Re: setting TMPDIR for shiny-server
parts:
I've found _a_ solution to my problem.  Setting TMPDIR=XXX in a .Renviron file in the home directory of the user that runs the service is effective.  This is probably less than ideal for running a service, but I already have a .Rprofile file to make cairo graphics work so I'll be satisfied with this solution.

Gareth
